wrap_habitat_env_as_gym: wrap a Habitat RLEnv into an OpenAI Gym compatible environment using HabGymWrapper
flatten_nested_dict: create a function that recursively flattens a nested dictionary into a single level with concatenated keys
smash_observation_space: build a gym Box space by smashing together multiple 1D observation spaces into one flattened space
step_gym_wrapped_env: run a step on the Gym-wrapped Habitat environment with a numpy array action and get observations
render_habitat_observation: render the last Habitat observation as an RGB array image using the HabGymWrapper render method
